_doc: Drop-in window backdrops for the arched study window. Save a PNG named meadow.png, alpine.png or harbor.png in this folder and it replaces the procedural scene automatically (no code changes). Rebuild the app after adding files.

worldWindowRect._note: Window opening in diorama world units (world is 440 x 820). The arch clips the top: an ellipse from (38,155) over the apex at y=20 to (402,155).

safeArea._note: Keep important art inside this 1200x960 region; 'cover' crops the left/right edges to fit the window.

anchors._note: Interactive props are still drawn by the engine on top of your art at these world positions, so leave the ground here visually clear.

layers._note: Optional parallax: add <scene>_far.png and <scene>_near.png (same 1200x960 canvas) and they are drawn behind/in front of the procedural squirrels.
